eun.translation:
n. (Eun)人名；(柬)恩
abbr. 内源性尿氮（endogenous urinary nitrogen）

eunarcon.translation: 优纳康(巴比妥类催眠药)

eunatrol.translation: 优纳特罗耳, 油酸钠

eunectes.translation: [网络] 水蚺属；绿森蚺；安纳康达

eunectes murinus.translation: [网络] 森蚺；绿森蚺；绿水蚺

eunice.translation: n. 尤妮斯（女子名, 义为快乐的胜利）

eunicea.translation: 矶沙蚕总科; 矶沙蚕总科

eunicidae.translation: 矶沙蚕科; 矶沙蚕科

eunomia.translation:
n. [希神]欧诺弥亚(季节三女神之一,意为良好秩序) 
n. =eunomy

eunomian.definition:
n. A follower of Eunomius, bishop of Cyzicus (4th century A.
   D.), who held that Christ was not God but a created being, having a
   nature different from that of the Father.
a. Of or pertaining to Eunomius or his doctrine.

eunomianism.translation: n. 优诺米主义,极端阿里乌主义(公元4 世纪基督教神学家优诺米)

eunomic.translation: a. 守法的, (社会秩序)良好的,井井有条的

eunomy.definition: n. Equal law, or a well-adjusted constitution of government.

eunuch.definition: n. a man who has been castrated and is incapable of reproduction
eunuch.translation:
n. 太监, 阉人, 无能者
[医] 去睾者, 无睾者, 阉人

eunuchism.definition: n. The state of being eunuch.
eunuchism.translation: n. [医]阉人状态(无睾丸之男性)

eunuchoid.translation:
n. 似阉人
a. 似阉人的, 惧内的

eunuchoid gigantism.translation: [医] 无睾性巨人症, 阉性巨人症

eunuchoidism.definition: n the state of being a eunuch (either because of lacking testicles or because they failed to develop)

eunuchs.definition: n. a man who has been castrated and is incapable of reproduction
eunuchs.translation: n. 太监, 宦官( eunuch的复数形式 )
